correctness.rationale: For row sum k, the constants are an invariant line with eigenvalue k. In quotient coordinates x_i−x_3, the quotient matrix is D_ij=A_ij−A_3j for i,j<3. Trace zero, determinant zero, and positive sum q of the principal 2-minors give exactly the quotient polynomial t(t²+q); the resulting four eigenvalues are simple. The frozen analytic bound q≤3 at k=3 follows from tr(A²)≥Σ A_ii²≥3. I independently enumerated all row choices at k=1,2,3 using the quotient predicate and weak connectivity. Simultaneous conjugacy and balanced-block testing over all 13 proper partitions reproduced labeled counts 1560/840/176, orbit counts 65/36/8, synchrony counts (0,47,18)/(1,27,8)/(2,5,1), all 109 frozen CSV entries, and the three displayed representatives. Equal incoming multiplicities give equal multisets and hence equal derivatives on the polydiagonal; unequal multiplicities can be detected by a smooth input-symmetric sum of interpolating functions. The k=1 replay had no cases; k=2 had 216 labeled cases in nine classes, five with one proper partition and four with two. Valency zero cannot have the imaginary pair. Thus three is minimal independently of the cited lower-valency results.
residual_risks: The census is exact for weakly connected four-cell directed multigraphs with loops and multiplicities; it is not a classification of dynamical equivalence or nonlinear bifurcations.
